title: Eyes Without a Face
youtubeDescription:
Eyes Without a Face — a privacy-first hybrid AI integration builder for #BuildHybridAI 2026.

Private CRM records stay in the browser. Gemini Nano can read field names on-device. Gemini in the cloud sees only a Phantom Twin — aliases and invented examples — after you approve one exact request. The mapping runs locally. Structure and meaning are reported separately. The export is a Node package with no records inside.

This video walks the current three-stage product on fictional data. The on-screen mapping in the product segment is the labelled simulated test planner, not a live Gemini call, so every screen is visible without waiting on the provider. Architecture, checks, and privacy rules are the real product.

Live demo: https://eyes-without-a-face-b7281.web.app
Code: https://github.com/RaulMermans/Eyes-Without-A-Face

Voice: Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0), voice am_michael.
All data is fictional.

Edits: motion-graphics scenes cut to voice; product walkthrough is one Playwright capture of the real UI; idle waits trimmed; no results were patched.

lines.text: Eyes Without a Face. Build integrations for systems your A.I. cannot see.
lines.caption: Phantom Twin Engine · #BuildHybridAI 2026

lines.text: You need to move private records into a new system. A cloud model could write that mapping in seconds.
lines.caption: A cloud model could map it in seconds.

lines.text: But names, emails, internal notes are not allowed to leave this machine. Pasting a few rows into a chat is the leak you were trying to avoid.
lines.caption: Private records cannot leave this machine.

lines.text: EYES is a hybrid A.I. integration builder. Private data stays in the browser. Gemini Nano can read field names on the device.
lines.caption: On-device understanding. Records never leave.

lines.text: The cloud sees only a Phantom Twin: meaningless aliases and invented examples. And only after you approve one exact request.
lines.caption: Phantom Twin · aliases + invented examples · one approval.

lines.text: Stage one. Add your data. A fictional C.R.M. Three records, six fields. Parsed here. Nothing has left the browser.
lines.caption: Stage 1 · Add your data · stays in this browser

lines.text: Stage two. Choose a destination. The helpdesk schema is on screen. Build prepares the request, and stops.
lines.caption: Stage 2 · Destination · Build stops at approval

lines.text: This is the trust boundary. Gemini will receive aliases, invented rows, and the destination. Not your records. Not your field names. You approve this exact prompt. One use.
lines.caption: One request · approved by you · single use

lines.text: A planner proposes how each destination field gets its value. Eight allowed operations. Data, not generated code. In this walkthrough, that planner is the labelled test adapter, not a live Gemini call, so you can see every screen.
lines.caption: Declarative operations · labelled test planner (not Gemini)

lines.text: Where a match is unsure, EYES asks. You translate the business states. A suggestion is never treated as a decision.
lines.caption: You decide meaning. Suggestions are not decisions.

lines.text: The mapping runs on your records, on this device. Structure and meaning are reported separately. Schema-valid is not the same as correct. Unknown is never a pass.
lines.caption: Local checks · structure ≠ meaning · unknown ≠ pass

lines.text: Stage three. Download the transformed records, and a portable package that runs with plain Node. No records in the zip. No field names. Hashes pinned.
lines.caption: Stage 3 · Check & export · package has no records

lines.text: On a frozen holdout, complete integrations rose from one in eighteen to nine in eighteen. Zero falsely verified records. Zero invented values. About half of hard cases still need a person. EYES is an assisted mapper, not an autonomous one.
lines.caption: 9 / 18 complete · 0 false verification · assisted mapper

lines.text: Local A.I. for private understanding. Cloud A.I. for design. Deterministic checks for the truth. Eyes Without a Face.
lines.caption: eyes-without-a-face-b7281.web.app
